name: GEdit-Bench
intro: GEdit-Bench是一个基于真实世界用户指令的图像编辑评测基准。它旨在提供一个更真实、更全面的评估框架，以衡量图像编辑模型的性能。该基准的发布旨在缩小开源模型与领先的闭源模型（如GPT-4o和Gemini）在图像编辑能力上的差距。
build_method: 真实用户数据收集, 人工筛选, 双语标注
metric: VIEScore: Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, Overall
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
eval_feature: 真实用户指令, 双语评测, VLM-as-Judge
scale: 606个双语图像编辑实例、11个类别
build_method_en: Real-user Collection, Human Filtering, Bilingual Annotation
intro_en: GEdit-Bench is an image editing evaluation benchmark based on real-world user instructions. It aims to provide a more realistic and comprehensive framework for assessing the performance of image editing models. The benchmark is released to narrow the gap in image editing capabilities between open-source models and leading closed-source models such as GPT-4o and Gemini.
metric_en: VIEScore: Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, Overall

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2504.17761. The Step1X-Edit paper builds GEdit-Bench from more than 1,000 real Internet editing instances, including Reddit-style user requests. Human reviewers assign 11 editing categories and remove similar-purpose instructions to preserve diversity. User-uploaded images are de-identified by reverse-searching multiple public search engines and substituting visually and semantically consistent public images; if no substitute exists, the instruction is minimally modified while preserving intent and image–instruction fidelity. Every retained image receives English and Chinese instructions, yielding 606 public examples. Open and proprietary editors are evaluated on the full set; common valid-output intersections contain 434 English and 422 Chinese examples. VIEScore uses GPT-4.1 and Qwen2.5-VL-72B judges to report Semantic Consistency, Perceptual Quality, and Overall Score.
